system.description:
Starting at 18th level your illusory power has reached levels capable of making someone lose trust in themselves. By spending 3 Actualization die, a creature under the effect of a Genjutsu you cast or are concentrating on that you also summon a Duplicity to match using the Betray Your Friend feature begins to suffer an identity crisis as voices fill their heads telling them they were never who they thought they were. The affected creature must make a Charisma saving throw vs your Genjutsu save DC to avoid falling for the ultimate deception. On a

Failed save they believe themselves to be the ultimate enemy to themselves. For the next minute they have an Identity Crisis. Creatures with an Identity Crisis can remake this save at the end of each of their turns to end this effect.
